no_adcom_quote.quote: A Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) meeting was not held to discuss the nintedanib IPF application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the OFEV (nintedanib) IPF application. FDA reviewers (SumR, CrossR, MedR) agreed that a Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) was not needed because the three one-year trials provided convincing, replicated FVC benefit with a numerical mortality trend, and the safety profile would not preclude approval for a life-threatening disease with no available therapy. With no uncertainty on efficacy or safety that would affect approval, no AdComm influenced the final approval.
